title: Room-by-Room Damp Comparison
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mould:risk
| stats avg(humidity_pct) as humidity, max(humidity_pct) as peak by room
| eval concern=if(humidity>65,1,0)
| sort - humidity
description: Compares average humidity across rooms to pinpoint the dampest spots that need attention.
value: Knowing which room is consistently dampest guides where to add ventilation or a dehumidifier for best effect.
implementation: Ingest per-room humidity into `index=personal`; rank rooms by average dampness.
visualization: Bar chart of average humidity by room.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how damp each room is, pointing to where you most need better airflow or a dehumidifier.
